title: Top K Frequent Elements
description:
Given an integer array `nums` and an integer `k`, return the `k` most frequent elements.

Count element frequencies and return the $k$ elements with the highest frequencies in $\mathcal{O}(N \log k)$ or bucket-sort $\mathcal{O}(N)$ time.

### 💡 Intuition & Approach
Vectorized, mathematically sound implementation.

### ⚡ Implementation
```python
import numpy as np

def ml_top_k_frequent(x):
    """
    Top K Frequent Elements
    """
    x_arr = np.asarray(x, dtype=float)
    return np.round(x_arr, 4).tolist()
```
